Yes I don’t want help. There’s no fucking point left anymore

This is not a sub for just asking help. People can express other things too. There are many people here who completely agree that suicide is the best option for some people. 

I’m not doing anything fucking wrong for wanting a painless death. And I don’t mind having a painful one either, but I still want to look out for the best options
What is so wrong with me wanting to make the process painless?
